title: "Reuses privacy-linter's exact content-class vocabulary" overstates provenance for 2 of 5 classes
notes: direct_pii/secret/metadata are genuinely privacy-linter's vocabulary (grep-confirmed: scan_diff.py only ever emits these 3 leak_class values). stylometric is NOT privacy-linter's -- it's produced by style-obfuscator's --emit-findings bridge, a different skill. inference_cue is produced by nothing anywhere in the repo -- privacy-linter's own SKILL.md explicitly says it does NOT cover inference-cue leaks (blocked on a local-model decision). The phrase 'reuses privacy-linter's exact content-class vocabulary' is repeated near-verbatim in decision-rubric.md's Inputs table. Medium severity: someone integrating privacy-linter alone with oracle could reasonably expect a privacy-linter scan to eventually surface all 5 classes -- it never will for 2 of them.

title: track_findings.py's --commit/last_verified_commit field is write-only, never read back
notes: Stored in every record via upsert_finding() but never compared or referenced in check_ledger() -- purely decorative today. Also missing --help text unlike --source-ref. Low severity: trivial internal detail, no user-facing consequence either way. Found during a repo-pincer self-audit.
